method: One fresh WebView2 profile per artifact, on the same Windows device, with identical actions and six one-second samples per phase except the startup snapshot.

workload.control: This spelling is accepted in both tested locales and both builds. The original comma defect is tested independently.
workload.clocks: Switch from UI action to applied language. Calculation from UI action to checked canonical DOM result and worker admission.

limitations: Cold startup has one measurement per artifact. Visible-window measurements include benchmark observation and rendering overhead.
With twelve interactions per artifact, the nearest-rank p95 and p99 are the largest observation.
Short bursts and idle windows describe this pair. They cannot establish long-run growth or an exclusive incremental physical RAM total.
Shared working sets are summed by process and may count shared mappings more than once. System physical memory also reflects unrelated activity.

baseline.method: Interactive Windows WebView2. Fresh profile, ordered checked calculations, Win32 sampling of host and auxiliary processes.
